Daniel Tracey

Architectural Designer · Atlanta, GA

I'm an architectural designer whose practice spans production housing, hospitality, education, commercial interiors, and new construction. Across five studios, I've moved through every phase of a project: schematic design, design development, construction documents, site observation, quality control, RFI resolution, and the client-facing work of turning a design decision into something buildable.

Alongside project work, I build custom AutoLISP and DCL tools that streamline AutoCAD documentation. My academic work has earned First Prize in the Resin Architecture International Design Competition, Second Prize in Autodesk's Make It Modular competition, and two Super Jury exhibitions. I hold a B.S. in Architectural Studies from the University of Arkansas with Highest Distinction and am continuing my education, and pursuing licensure, at Georgia Tech.
